item.title: Strickland Metals Outlines Maiden Gold Resource at Gradina as Rogozna Growth Continues
item.description: Strickland Metals (ASX: STK) has delivered a maiden Inferred Mineral Resource Estimate of 1.2 million ounces of gold for the Gradina deposit at its Rogozna project in Serbia.

item.title: Marmota Confirms Spectacular Bonanza-Grade Assays Across Nearly 1km at Greenewood
item.description: Marmota (ASX: MEU) has reported final assays from its maiden Greenewood drilling program that confirm multiple bonanza grades close to surface and outline a high-grade mineralised system extending for almost 900 metres along strike.

item.title: Intelligent Monitoring Group Makes Major New Zealand Acquisition To Accelerate Commercial Growth
item.description: Intelligent Monitoring Group (ASX: IMB) has agreed to acquire Tyco New Zealand and Red Wolf Security in a deal that materially expands its fire protection and high-level security footprint across New Zealand.

item.title: Amaero Reports 60% Reduction in Capital Costs of Planned Argon Recycling Plant
item.description: Amaero (ASX: 3DA) has reported considerable capital savings for its planned argon gas recycling plant in Tennessee and ordered the plant’s fourth EIGA Premium atomiser, accelerating its growth of US powder production capacity.

item.title: Verity Resources On Target for a Major MRE Upgrade at Monument Gold Project
item.description: Verity Resources (ASX: VRL) is on target for a significant mineral resource estimate upgrade for its Monument gold project in Western Australia after a completing a two-phase drill program.

item.title: Red Mountain Mining Technical Study Confirms Prolific Status of Silver Dollar Antimony District
item.description: A technical study on Red Mountain Mining’s (ASX: RMX) Silver Dollar antimony project in Idaho has highlighted the district’s prolific status, with nearby prospects reporting historical assays of up to 85.7 grams per tonne silver and 17.5g/t gold.

item.title: Fenix Resources Outlines Three-Year Production Plan to Consolidate Weld Ridge Project
item.description: Fenix Resources (ASX: FEX) has released a three-year production plan that establishes a pathway to reach up to 6Mtpa by FY28, consolidating mining at the Weld Range project as the Iron Ridge and Shine operations approach the end of their current mine lives.

item.title: AKORA Resources Confirms Support for Bekisopa Iron Ore Project from New Madagascan Government
item.description: AKORA Resources (ASX: AKO) has attracted support from Madagascar’s senior government leaders for the transition of the Bekisopa high-grade iron ore project licence from exploration to mining.

item.title: Brightstar Resources Lifts Mineral Resource at Menzies Project by 22%
item.description: Brightstar Resources (ASX: BTR) has increased the MRE at its Menzies gold project following infill and extensional drilling undertaken during 2025, delivering a 22% increase in total contained gold to 0.7 million ounces at 1.5 grams per tonne.

item.title: Metals Powder Works Produces High-Purity Silver Powder Using Patented New Process
item.description: Metal Powder Works (ASX: MPW) has expanded its specialty materials portfolio with the production of high-purity silver powder utilising its patented DirectPowder process.
